facts.text: There are no gas or petrol stations in Yosemite Valley, but electric vehicle charging stations are available.
facts.quote: There are no gas/petrol stations in the Yosemite Valley.

facts.text: State Route 120 from the east (Tioga Pass Road) is only open when free of snow, usually May to October, so check road conditions in advance.
facts.quote: only open when free of snow (usually May - October)

facts.text: Be sure to fill your gas tank in Oakhurst, or you may pay dearly as you get closer to the park.
facts.quote: fill your gas tank in Oakhurst

facts.text: During summer months traffic becomes heavily congested in Yosemite Valley, and parking can be nearly impossible to find.
facts.quote: traffic becomes heavily congested in Yosemite Valley

facts.text: Fresno Yosemite International Airport has YARTS bus service to Yosemite during the summer months.
facts.quote: Has YARTS bus service to Yosemite during the summer months.

facts.text: From Merced Airport, take the YARTS shuttle to reach Yosemite.
facts.quote: To reach Yosemite, take the YARTS shuttle.

facts.text: Weather can change rapidly during all seasons and varies greatly with elevation, so pack layered clothing and rain gear.
facts.quote: Weather can change rapidly during all seasons of the year

facts.text: Summer is typically warm and dry with occasional thunderstorms, with temperatures from 50°F to the low 90°F range.
Fall and spring are highly variable; rain is less likely early in fall or late in spring, while rain or snow is likely late in fall or early in spring.
facts.quote: Rain is less likely early in fall/late in spring and rain or snow is likely late in fall/early in spring.

facts.text: Entrance fees are valid for seven days and allow unlimited re-entry for the week.
facts.quote: Entrance fees are valid for seven days

facts.text: Advance reservations are not needed in 2026.
facts.quote: Advance reservations are not needed in 2026.

facts.text: Entrance fees as of 2024 include $35 for private vehicles, with no per person fee.
facts.quote: $35 for private vehicles (no per person fee).

facts.text: During the snow season, usually November through March, snow chains may be required.
Chain requirements are strictly enforced in Yosemite, with potential fines as much as $5,000, so chains should be carried during those months.
facts.quote: Chain requirements are strictly enforced in Yosemite with potential fines being as much as $5,000
